function.arguments: {"finding": "The email channel was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who have higher baseline conversion rates. Without stratification, the raw conversion rate shows email (38%) > paid_search (31%), which would suggest email is better. However, after adjusting for customer segment (stratified by segment), the weighted conversion rate shows paid_search (39.3%) > email (25.9%). This reversal is due to segment imbalance: email had more loyal customers (131 vs 26), who convert more regardless of channel. Thus, the raw difference is confounded. The correct estimate requires adjustment.", "implication": "The campaign's success cannot be assessed by raw conversion rate. We must stratify by customer segment to isolate the channel effect. The raw comparison is misleading."}
function.name: note_finding
